note: Each verification entry references the real project file defining the command. Entries are truthful about what each command proves at the current phase.

commands.name: typecheck
commands.whatItProves: Strict TypeScript compiles with no type errors.

commands.name: test
commands.whatItProves: Unit and adapter tests pass (69 tests at Phase 2).

commands.name: test:contract
commands.whatItProves: Shared storage contract suite passes for the local adapter.

commands.name: build
commands.whatItProves: TypeScript emits a clean build into dist/.

commands.name: security:secrets
commands.whatItProves: No high-signal secret patterns in tracked files.

commands.name: security:audit
commands.whatItProves: Production dependency tree is clean. Dev-only brace-expansion advisory on the ESLint minimatch chain is documented, pinned to best available versions, and does not fail the command.

commands.name: bootstrap
commands.whatItProves: Idempotent environment + directory bootstrap succeeds without Shelby credentials; opens the collection index and runs migrations + seed.

commands.name: migration:replay
commands.whatItProves: Migration replay is deterministic: runs twice to schema version 1 with the seed caller present and no duplicates.

commands.name: auth:smoke
commands.whatItProves: Real HTTP authorization flows against the local index: seeded dev caller seals (201); unknown key denied (403 FORBIDDEN); missing Authorization denied (401); another caller's collection hidden as 404 COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND.

commands.name: runtime:proof
commands.whatItProves: Local seal-to-verify vertical slice over HTTP with fresh evidence under evidence/: multipart seal (201), verify (verified), artifact download with SHA-256 digest match. Shelby testnet remains unverified (Phase 6).

commands.name: start
commands.whatItProves: Boots the ProofVault API with the local driver; fail-closed on STORAGE_DRIVER=shelby.
